name: core-seats
description: Seats' seats on a table, D104: a caller takes a seat for itself, or seats and unseats another, a full seat refuses a take or displaces the subject seated longest, and a field's subject is seated and cannot leave, an update that gives the field a new subject held to the seat's max; a Workflow transition's by and a StateRules state's by name a seat (seat:<name>), with overridePermission past it; with each one's define refusals. Cases written by hand in the recorded format, since no engine implements Seats. Each answer holds what the replayer compares: a record's id, data and behaviors, an operation's result, and a refusal whole, in the core's words; what only the engine's store answers (sequence numbers, versions, timestamps, the document a define echoes) is left out.
